text: Ordinary names shall match ASCII `[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*` and be case-sensitive. Sigils shall immediately precede their names: `@`, `$`, `%`, and `^` for value/type binders, constants, SSA values, and blocks respectively.
